findings: Fresh restart revalidates the diagnostic collector against pinned public DataSource/Feature APIs instead of accepting the historical collector by existence.
Diagnostic scope is acquisition evidence only: identify installed-MWM shop/convenience features and their metadata without promoting final renderer behavior.
Presentation evidence must remain diagnostic-only; stock vehicle style z17/z18 behavior is recorded separately from CB6 final presentation.
No external web source is implementation authority; exact pinned CoMaps source is sufficient for this diagnostic revalidation.
DataSource::ForEachInRect iterates features from registered local MWM indexes at a requested scale.
FeatureType exposes type iteration, center, names and FMD_BRAND/FMD_OPERATOR metadata needed by the diagnostic collector.
brand metadata can be dropped when equal to a feature name, so diagnostic output must not treat missing FMD_BRAND as missing POI.
Pinned vehicle style presents shop=convenience generically from z17 and text from z18; this is a presentation limitation, not proof of missing MWM data.
MwmActivity provides a post-render Android boundary suitable only for visible diagnostic evidence.
Native Feature type, center, names and metadata are sufficient to observe convenience POIs in installed MWM data.
shop/convenience type is the acquisition gate; brand/operator/name are diagnostic identity inputs and brand metadata may legitimately be absent.
Stock map presentation begins at z17; diagnostic UI may expose count after rendering without being accepted as final renderer implementation.
Feature acquisition reads registered local MWM indexes and metadata, preserving offline operation.
Public DataSource iteration is the pinned installed-MWM acquisition boundary used by the diagnostic.
